headline: The days they won't remember that you'll keep for both of you
items: The first walk they slept through the whole way, and you didn't mind
A rainy Thursday on the couch, one blanket, one baby
The first time they turned to the window, like light was news
A stranger in line saying they were the tiniest thing she'd seen
turn: They'll keep none of it. That's why you keep it twice.
